nodes.summary: A charge sequence is an arbitrary sequence $(z_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of complex numbers, read as the positions of the charges.
nodes.title: Charge sequences

nodes.summary: There is no charge sequence $(z_n)$ whose positions are pairwise distinct, which is summable ($z_n \neq 0$ for every $n$ and $\sum_n 1/|z_n| < \infty$), and whose field $\sum_n 1/(z - z_n)$ is nonzero at every point $z \in \mathbb{C}$ that is not one of the $z_n$.
nodes.title: The equilibrium-free logarithmic potential conjecture is false

nodes.summary: The conjecture states that there exists a charge sequence $(z_n)$ whose positions are pairwise distinct, which is summable ($z_n \neq 0$ for every $n$ and $\sum_n 1/|z_n| < \infty$), and whose field $\sum_n 1/(z - z_n)$ is nonzero at every point $z \in \mathbb{C}$ that is not one of the $z_n$.
nodes.title: Equilibrium-free logarithmic potential conjecture

nodes.summary: For a charge sequence $(z_n)$ and a point $z \in \mathbb{C}$, the field at $z$ is the sum $\sum_n 1/(z - z_n)$, where a term with $z_n = z$ counts as $0$ and the sum is taken to be $0$ when the family $\bigl(1/(z - z_n)\bigr)_n$ is not summable.
nodes.title: Field of a charge sequence

nodes.summary: A charge sequence $(z_n)$ is summable when $z_n \neq 0$ for every $n$ and $\sum_n 1/|z_n| < \infty$.
nodes.title: Summable charge sequences

nodes.summary: A charge sequence $(z_n)$ has distinct positions when its terms are pairwise distinct: $z_m \neq z_n$ whenever $m \neq n$.
nodes.title: Distinct charge positions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
